name: MTO/CTO Order Intelligence Agent
description: Read-only assistant for production planners and fulfillment teams. Consolidates SAP S/4HANA sales orders and their linked production orders into a single view, flags production exceptions, explains risk with source evidence, and recommends next actions.

skills.name: Unified Order View
skills.description: Retrieves a sales order with all linked production orders, confirmations, and material availability and presents them as one consolidated view.
examples: Show me the status of sales order 0000012345
What production orders are linked to 0000012345?
What about the second production order?

skills.name: Exception Detection
skills.description: Identifies production orders with schedule slip, missing confirmation, quantity shortfall, material shortage, or status inconsistency, and ranks at-risk orders by severity.

skills.name: Risk Explanation
skills.description: Explains why an order is at risk, labelling every claim as a confirmed fact or an inferred risk and citing the source record and value behind it.
examples: Where does that confirmed date come from?

skills.name: Planner Recommendations
skills.description: Recommends concrete, ranked next actions with an owning role for each detected exception. Read-only: the agent never changes order data.
examples: What should I do about order 0000012345?
What is the most urgent thing to check today?

skills.name: Customer Status Summary
skills.description: Produces a short, jargon-free status summary suitable for a customer service representative, separating confirmed dates from estimates.
examples: Give me a customer-ready update for 0000012345
Write a summary I can send to the customer

scopes.order.read: Read sales order and production order data
